signs_and_coordinates: Build a physically causal triplex positive-displacement pump driven through a closed-loop shaft-speed actuator.
The pump must contain three crank-driven plungers phased 120 degrees apart, separate inlet and outlet check valves for every cylinder, finite fluid compliance and hydraulic manifolds.

Across the declared range, regulate the measured shaft speed to its commanded value, sustain positive delivered flow against the outlet pressure, retain bounded pressure and flow pulsation, and recover after the speed-command change.
feedback_and_control_causality: Build a physically causal triplex positive-displacement pump driven through a closed-loop shaft-speed actuator.

Across the declared range, regulate the measured shaft speed to its commanded value, sustain positive delivered flow against the outlet pressure, retain bounded pressure and flow pulsation, and recover after the speed-command change.
Every value must be measured from the causal pump, shaft, manifold, or check-valve paths.
